Commentary.Commentary: Welcome back for the run chase. The umpires and the players are out in the middle. Alice Walsh and Freya Sargent walk in with their blades for Ireland Women Under-19. Peace Usen has the new ball in hand and is raring to go. Let's play...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

With both teams wanting to win their last game of the tournament, its Ireland Women Under-19 to come out and chase 95 runs in 20 overs, and Nigeria Women Under-19 bowlers will come out and try and stop them. Let's see what happens in the Run chase, coming up...

Ireland Women Under-19 were brilliant with the new ball and at the field. The middle overs did see a lot of frustration in the field as the batters were running brilliantly between the wickets. The Ireland Women Under-19 still did not lose hope and kept taking wickets at regular intervals. With 95 runs as a target, Ireland Women Under-19 need a good start to the first 6 overs if they want to chase the total down.

Nigeria Women Under-19 get to their highest first-inning total in this tournament as a combined team batting effort took them to 94 runs in their quota of 20 overs in their last game of the tournament. The start from the batters was not really that bright as Ireland Women Under-19 managed to grab 4 quick wickets up top. It was the pair of Christabel Chukwuonye and Peculiar Agboya who both managed to stitch up a good partnership in the middle overs and then Peculiar Agboya went ahead to end the innings well for her team. Nigeria Women Under-19 stand on 94 runs in 20 overs, a target that looks a good one for the Ireland Women Under-19.
Slower one, outside off, Peculiar Agboya looks to slap it but misses. Nigeria Women Under-19 end their innings at 94/7!

Commentary.Commentary: Right then! All the pre-match formalities are done and we are ready for action. The Umpires and the players walk out and take the field to start the first session of the match. Victory Igbinedion and Christabel Chukwuonye are the opening batters for Nigeria Women Under-19. Jennifer Jackson has the new ball in hand to start the attack for Ireland Women Under-19. Let's Play!

The players and the match officials walk out to the field in straight lines for the respective National Anthems before the start of the match. It is the National anthem of Ireland first, followed by that of Nigeria.

Piety Lucky, the captain of the Nigeria Women Under-19 team, says that they wanted to bowl first as well, but they are prepared to bat first. She further adds that they have played a good brand of cricket so far and will continue to do so. Furthermore, she says that this tournament has been a life-changing one for her and the team, and they will take a lot of learnings back with them.

Niamh MacNulty, the skipper of Ireland Women Under-19, says that they would like to have a bowl first as the overhead conditions support the bowlers well in the first inning and they will want to take that advantage early in the game. She further adds that it has been a good learning for them in the tournament and they will go back home and use these learnings to become better at their skills.
